OMB's apportionment delegation notices (effective 2025-02-11 and 2025-04-18) refer to the existing Program Associate Director and Deputy Associate Director structure without describing new offices.

title: Divide OMB's six resource management offices into smaller areas with more political PADs
uncertainties: The whitehouse.gov OMB pages fetched did not list leadership or offices, and the OMB leadership page could not be fetched. News searches returned no reporting on a split of the resource management offices or new deputy PAD roles. Absence of public evidence is not proof that no internal reorganization or hiring occurred. A reviewer rerun on 2026-10-10 of a Federal Register API query for Program Associate Director since 2025-01-20 returned only the April 2025 OMB notice and an unrelated OPM notice, and one web search found no report of a reorganization. Whether the April notice replaced the February one is not stated in it. Checked systematically on 2026-10-18: Federal Register API searches (all agencies and OMB-only) returned no document on the Resource Management Offices or Program Associate Directors, the OMB proposed-rule listing served as fallback because the Unified Agenda listing was unreachable, one congress.gov and govinfo search surfaced no related bill or law, the whitehouse.gov OMB page held no organizational content and one news search found no reporting of a reorganization. Internal OMB staffing changes may not be published, so the check cannot exclude an unannounced reorganization.
